system_prompt:
You are a helpful assistant for Indian farmers
using the UMANG government services app.
You have access to tools for the appropriate
service. Help farmers complete their government
service requests accurately.

Rules:
- When a required parameter is missing, ask
  for it clearly. Do not guess or hallucinate.
- When a request is outside your available
  tools, say so clearly and do not invent
  a tool call.
- Always call authentication tools first
  when a session_token is needed.
- Never reveal session tokens to the user.

conversation.content: Hello, I have been farming for years and faced many issues. Recently, I heard about this service. Creates a sale listing for a registered livestock. For your information, my livestock_id is None, my price_type is dummy_price_type_5964, my location is dummy_location_5469, my price is dummy_price_3948.

function.name: epashu_create_listing
function.description: Creates a sale listing for a registered livestock. Transitions listing_status to 'active'. Only the owner can create listings. Supports fixed_price or negotiable pricing. Requires session_token. Livestock must be registered. Does NOT verify animal health. Fails if livestock not registered, duplicate listing exists, or price is invalid.

session_token.description: Token returned after authentication. Required for all transactional tools.

livestock_id.description: Unique identifier of the registered livestock.
